sections.heading: Cate Blanchett — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Cate Blanchett was born on 14 May 1969 in Melbourne, and holds Australian and American nationality. She was given the name Catherine Élise Blanchett at birth and is publicly known as Cate Blanchett.
She studied at National Institute of Dramatic Art, University of Melbourne and Ivanhoe Girls' Grammar School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Cate Blanchett — Career and Professional Work
paras: Cate Blanchett works primarily as a film producer, film director, stage actor, film actor and voice actor, with Dirty Films and University of Oxford listed among her employers.
She has held the following offices: President of the Jury at the Cannes Festival (2018–2018).
She has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018.
